notes.title: Cublast HD | Version 1.1.0.5 | Ready for NEON?
notes.notes:
Hello blasters!

The past few months we have been working on a big update. Cublast HD has been overhauled with a whole new neon style!

We have updated the game's levels, added a tutorial flow and you will now be able to add decals and change the colors of both players!

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27679267/80a3287ade7095869eee1993666e295ca2356182.png

Check out the new trailer and screenshots on our updated store page.

Changelog

[code]- Graphics overhaul
- Upgraded customization system
- Added a tutorial
- New stage 8
- More controller support[/code]

Sadly these updates lead to a clean up of our save system which means progress had to be reset. (*Hotfix*) Luckily your high scores are still intact which means that we are able to automatically restore your progress from the online high scores on first launch!

Let us know what you think of this update through the official Cublast Facebook page, or as always in the Discussions area of the Community Hub.

Enjoy the update!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.0 – Adaptive Soundtrack
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27679267/bebac217f69374c19a9bae1fa8bac3984de14a58.png

Hi Blasters!

Today is a good day, we are rolling out our all new adaptive soundtrack! This means that the more progress you make, the more rich and energetic the soundtrack becomes. We have also added a separate tune to the Level Editor and a randomized soundtracks to community levels.

The update is big, but it will be worth it. :)

Let us know what you think and as always, please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the  Discussions area of the  Community Hub.

notes.title: Cublast HD | Version 1.0.1.0 | New Coop & Versus Stage + 4 New Accent Colors!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27679267/ebdc43ef53d84a2d5ae26f5b061f78f508f0aee1.png

Fresh out of the oven!

In this update we added a stage to both coop and versus! In each stage you're able to unlock 2 accent colors. Have fun exploring and collecting the new accents! We now also have weekly highscores tab, so you can track who is the best that specific week!


Changelog
- Changing version to 1.0.1.0

Fixes
[code]
- Improved movement mechanics
    - Removed double jump on start.
    - Improved finish accessibility.
    - Jump reliability improved 
[/code]

New Features
[code]
- Coop & versus stage 
- 4 New accent colors
- Weekly high scores
[/code]

As always, please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the  Discussions area of the  Community Hub.

notes.title: Cublast HD | Update 1.3.817
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27679267/2623b67d8c5eafccd65bcf129d906fb64e656be6.png

What's up Blasters,

Today we are releasing a new update, containing multiple bug fixes and improvements for co-op & versus gameplay. Sadly this meant that we had to delay the release of our new stages.

We have chosen to delay the release of the stages to focus on fixing bugs. Of course we want to ensure the quality of our product, that means that we don't want to rush our content that is put out. The release date of the single player, co-op and versus stages will be postponed for one week. This week we will release a stage for both co-op & versus and next week there will be a new stage for single player to look out for!

Changelog

  Co-op and Versus fixes & improvements.

      Added a respawn delay in versus.
      Fixed players not dying in replays.
      Fixed reversing deaths and finish in replays.

  The game now launches in native resolution instead of 1024*768
  Fixed a bug where players were able to enter the finish cube from its underside.
  Updated release dates of new stages.


As always, please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the  Discussions area of the  Community Hub.

notes.title: Cublast HD | Update to Version 1.3.787
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27679267/2623b67d8c5eafccd65bcf129d906fb64e656be6.png

What's up Blasters,

Here's an update to fix a few little issues with the navigation and as always we've improved some bug fixes all listed below.

  Highscore Tabs: When quick switching between tabs, it didn't always load the right tab.
  Added a Upload Button: Due to confusing in uploading levels to the community, we've added a button in the main level editor menu. Uploading can now be done through that button or through Community > My Profile.
  Fixed Sound Bug Physics Cube: When the player pushed around a Physics Block while being upside down, the pushing sound would loop and repeat itself.
  Fixed Achievements: Some achievements weren't displayed correctly in the Steam Achievements menu.
  Miscelanousimnsssss Bug Fixes


As always, please continue to post your bug reports and feedback in the  Discussions area of the  Community Hub.

notes.title: Cublast HD | Development Update | 19th April 2017
notes.notes:
Introducing a new way to unlock artifacts!
Not only can you find them hidden in the stage, you can also get them when you complete a stage at 100%. This will give you even more accent colors and themes for customization!
